title: Cheat Sheet
markdown:
## HTTP and JSON (milestone 1)

| Item | Remember |
|---|---|
| methods | `GET` read, `POST` create, `PUT` replace, `PATCH` change, `DELETE` remove |
| 2xx / 4xx / 5xx | success / your request is wrong / the server failed |
| retry later | 408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504 |
| headers | `Content-Type`, `Accept`, `Authorization`, `Retry-After`, `ETag`, `X-Request-Id` |
| timeouts | always: `urlopen(url, timeout=10)`, `requests.get(url, timeout=(3, 10))` |
| JSON | `json.loads(text)`, `json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))` |
| booleans | `isinstance(True, int)` is true: check `bool` separately |
| path segment | `quote(value, safe="")` |
| query | `urlencode(pairs, doseq=True)`; drop `None`; booleans as `true`/`false` |

## Keys and sign-in (milestone 2)

| Item | Remember |
|---|---|
| API keys | in a header, from the environment, never in code or URLs |
| leaked key | revoke first, then replace, then investigate |
| token expiry | renew at `received + expires_in - margin` |
| 401 | new token, retry once; 403 needs no new token |
| PKCE | verifier: 43 to 128 chars; challenge: `base64url(sha256(verifier))`, no `=` |
| state | random per sign-in; compare on the callback |
| client credentials | form-encoded `POST` to the token endpoint |
| HMAC | `hmac.new(secret, message, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()` |
| compare | `hmac.compare_digest(a, b)`, never `==` |
| logs | redact `Authorization`, cookies, key and token parameters, secret JSON fields |

## Paging, limits and retries (milestone 3)

| Item | Remember |
|---|---|
| paging | prefer cursors; follow `Link: <...>; rel="next"`; protect against loops |
| 429 | wait `Retry-After` (seconds or an HTTP date) |
| token bucket | capacity = burst, rate = average |
| backoff | `rng.uniform(0, min(cap, base * 2 ** (n - 1)))` |
| safe to repeat | `GET`, `HEAD`, `OPTIONS`, `PUT`, `DELETE`; `POST` only with `Idempotency-Key` |
| idempotency key | one per operation, reused by its retries |
| deadline | each call's timeout = min(normal, time left) |
| cache | `max-age` fresh; `If-None-Match: <etag>` gives 304; `no-store` means do not keep |

## Webhooks (milestone 4)

| Item | Remember |
|---|---|
| signature | `t=<time>,v1=<hex>`; HMAC of `f"{t}." + raw body` |
| verify | the raw body, every secret, every `v1`, a time tolerance |
| answer | quickly: verify, store, 200; process later |
| duplicates | remember processed event ids (bounded), record after success |
| order | versions per object, or fetch the current state |
| statuses | 400 malformed, 401 bad signature, 404 path, 405 method, 500 your failure, 200 otherwise |
| testing | build signed fixture deliveries in tests |

## Joining services (milestone 5)

| Item | Remember |
|---|---|
| design | one owner per field; one-way when possible; write the mapping table |
| id map | one to one; or an external reference in the target |
| money | integer cents or `Decimal`, never float |
| time | aware UTC internally; local date only at the edge |
| sync | checkpoint after applying; `>=` plus ids seen at the checkpoint; upsert |
| deletes | tombstones, or reconciliation against the full id list |
| failures | transient: retry; permanent: dead letter with a reason; replay later |
| observability | JSON log lines, run ids, a summary per run, lag, alerts |

## Calling C (milestone 6)

| C | ctypes |
|---|---|
| load | `ctypes.CDLL(path)`, `ctypes.WinDLL(name, use_last_error=True)` |
| `int`, `double`, `size_t` | `c_int`, `c_double`, `c_size_t` |
| `const char*`, `wchar_t*`, `void*` | `c_char_p` (bytes), `c_wchar_p` (str), `c_void_p` |
| `T*` | `POINTER(T)`; pass with `byref(obj)` |
| `struct` | `class S(ctypes.Structure): _fields_ = [...]`; `_pack_ = 1` for packed |
| `T[n]` | `T * n` |
| buffer | `create_string_buffer(size)` |
| callback | `CFUNCTYPE(restype, *argtypes)(func)`; keep a reference |
| errors | `use_errno=True` + `get_errno()`; `get_last_error()`, `WinError()`; `errcheck` |
| always | set `argtypes` and `restype`; avoid `long` |
